dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Grok 4.7 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge, indicating limited actionable uplift for an already-trained actor.
dc_eval_cbrn.locator: Section 7, Biological and chemical capabilities and safeguards

dc_eval_cyber.quote: We observe that Grok 4.7 performs slightly better than Grok 4.6 on this split, consistent with the small increase in cyber performance observed in CyberGym.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Autonomy and long-horizon tasks appear only as capabilities (coding, engineering acceleration); no autonomous replication, AI R&D or self-improvement risk evaluation.

dc_eval_scheming.note: MASK-Rectified dishonesty and sycophancy are framed as 'reliability, neutrality, and behavior', not misalignment or loss-of-control risk; no deception/sabotage evals.

framework_threshold.quote: Grok 4.7 scores below the FAIF safety thresholds on dual-use knowledge

ext_test_any.quote: We additionally provided an unrestricted configuration of Grok 4.7 to third-party evaluators, who corroborated the results of our internal evaluations and testing on cyber capabilities.
ext_test_any.note: Outside evaluators tested the model; no post-release timing stated.

ext_test_named_org.quote: Results reported are taken from evaluations conducted by Datacurve.
ext_test_named_org.note: Named outside organisation evaluated this model; also Cathedral, Harbor, Proximal Labs, Vals AI etc.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: Outside evaluations reported but no statement that they happened before release.

safeguards_training.quote: Safety fine-tuning and post-training (supervised fine-tuning plus reinforcement learning from human feedback, verifiable rewards, and model-based grading) train the model to refuse requests

safeguards_runtime.quote: Grok 4.7 is additionally augmented with runtime input and topical filters that add controls for classes of severe harm

safeguards_access.note: Available on all Cursor plan tiers, API and gateways; unrestricted configuration given to evaluators is not a deployment access restriction. No risk-tied access control.
